items.exampleEn: In the crowded elevator, I felt uneasy with so many strangers in close proximity.
items.exampleZh: 在擁擠的電梯裡，那麼多陌生人緊挨著我，讓我很不自在。

items.exampleEn: Huge offshore wind farms now produce power for thousands of homes.
items.exampleZh: 巨大的離岸風場現在為數千戶人家供電。

items.exampleEn: Every dorm room has two beds, two desks and a small fridge.
items.exampleZh: 每間宿舍房間都有兩張床、兩張書桌和一台小冰箱。

items.exampleEn: Life on the city's outskirts is quieter, but the bus ride downtown is long.
items.exampleZh: 住在城市外圍比較安靜，但搭公車到市中心要很久。

items.exampleEn: In history books, a ghetto is the part of a city where one group of people lived apart from others.
items.exampleZh: 在歷史書裡，ghetto 指城市中某一群人與其他人分開居住的區域。

items.exampleEn: The children cut paper into triangles, squares and a pentagon.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們把紙剪成三角形、正方形和一個五角形。

items.exampleEn: Learning a second language can be a gateway to jobs around the world.
items.exampleZh: 學第二語言可能是通往世界各地工作的門路。

items.exampleEn: The museum has a large collection of Aboriginal art from Australia.
items.exampleZh: 那間博物館收藏了大量來自澳洲的原住民藝術品。

items.sentenceEn: First-year students must live in the dorm on campus.
items.sentenceZh: 一年級學生必須住在校內的宿舍。

items.audioEn: The airport is the gateway to the island, so most visitors arrive there by plane.
items.audioZh: 機場是通往這座島的門戶，所以大部分遊客都搭飛機抵達。
items.questionZh: 大部分遊客怎麼到這座島？

items.sentenceEn: We rented a small house on the outskirts of the town.
items.sentenceZh: 我們在鎮外圍租了一間小房子。

items.sentenceEn: Aboriginal people have lived in this land for thousands of years.
items.sentenceZh: 原住民已經在這片土地上生活了好幾千年。

items.stemEn: The house is expensive because of its ____ to good schools.
items.stemZh: 這間房子很貴，因為它離好學校很近。

items.stemEn: A ____ has five sides and five corners.
items.stemZh: 五邊形有五個邊和五個角。

items.passageEn: This summer, I joined a history tour of an old port city. Our first stop was the old ghetto, a historic area where a small community once lived. Today, it is a quiet area full of cafés and bookshops. Next, we walked to the stone gateway that once protected the city. Our guide pointed out the city's proximity to the sea and explained why trade made it rich. In the afternoon, we took a boat to visit a small offshore island. That night, I stayed in a student dorm on the outskirts of town, which was cheap and surprisingly cozy.
items.passageZh: 今年夏天，我參加了一個古老港口城市的歷史導覽。第一站是舊的聚居區，那是一個歷史街區，以前有一個小社群住在那裡。如今，那裡是一個寧靜的地區，到處都是咖啡館和書店。接著，我們走到以前保護城市的石造城門。導覽員指出這座城市鄰近海洋，並解釋貿易為什麼讓它富裕起來。下午，我們搭船去參觀一座離岸的小島。那天晚上，我住在鎮外圍的學生宿舍，價格便宜，而且出乎意料地溫馨。

questions.questionZh: 那個舊聚居區如今是什麼樣子？
options: 到處是空無一人的廢墟

questions.questionZh: 作者那天晚上住在哪裡？

items.promptZh: 很多大公司把工廠蓋在城市外圍。
referenceEn: Many big companies build their factories on the outskirts of the city.
Many large companies put their factories on the outskirts of cities.
rubricZh: 「在城市外圍」可寫，例如 on the outskirts of the city 等
時態合理即可（例如 build、built）

items.instructionZh: 用 dorm 造一個句子，說說你住宿舍的經驗或對宿舍生活的想法。
referenceEn: I lived in a dorm in my first year at university, and I made many friends.
I think living in a dorm teaches you to share and be patient.
